entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE KISHORE KUMAR  MANDAL  ORAL ORDER 2 29-04-2013 Learned counsel for the petitioner and Mr. Jha APP for the State are present.

Let the petitioner implead the informant of Fatuha P.S. Case No. 275/2012 as opposite party nop.2 25 tins of ghee each measuring 15 kg. was/were seized and the petitioner was made an accused under sections 272 & 273 IPC and 31 of the Food Safety and Standard Act.
The prayer of the petitioner for release of the tins of ghee was rejected by the learned Addl. Sessions Judge, Patna under order dated 18.01.2013 passed in Special Case No. 10A/2012.
Let learned APP take instruction from the concerned opposite party and file counter affidavit within two weeks.

The petitioner shall also file an affidavit stating therein as to whether any confiscation proceeding,
in the meanwhile, has been initiated under appropriate jurisdiction of the provisions of law applicable to the present case.
Dr. Jha will also take instruction with respect to the report, if any, received from the concerned laboratory in respect of gee seized from the possession of the petitioner.
Post this matter on 18th June, 2013 in Admission II.

(Kishore Kumar Mandal, J) HR/-
